setspec.lessonname: B5 Optim Practice of Japanese-English word pairs

unit.unitinstructions:
Memory for Japanese vocabulary

Please read all of the text below carefully, it necessary to successfully complete the task.

Task: You learn 30 different Japanese-English word pairs by repeatedly studying them for 20 minutes.
-For each pair, you will initially study the complete pair.
-On subsequent trials for a word pair, you will be asked to fill in the missing English word '__________'.
-On fill-in-the-blank trials, you must hit ENTER key after typing to submit your response.
-Try to guess or remember the answers for the blanks, and if you cannot guess, just press ENTER to read the correct answer.
-If you get a fill-in-the-blank answer wrong, you will be given a review with the correct answer for 4 seconds.
-You have 7 seconds when reading for study and 7 seconds to begin typing the answers for fill-in-the-blank trials.
-Please make sure this window is maximized before you begin.
When you are ready, press continue button to proceed to the next screen.

Demographic Survey

Thank you for completeing the previous task. To finish up, please answer the following quick demographic questions, which may be useful for us to understand the data we collect.
